title: Position row
description: One venue position as the `positions` topic carries it. A flat position stays with size "0". Total PnL = realizedPnlSinceFlat + unrealizedPnl + funding. Mirrors src/panel/model/frames.ts (PositionRow). See decision 0007 part 2 §9.1.

id.description: Includes the side in hedge mode.

fundingSinceChange.description: Funding since the position's last change of size, the exchange's own figure; paid negative, received positive. Added 2026-10-06: absent from an older runtime's row.

returnOnEquity.description: Optional venue ROE ratio (not percent), including zero. Older rows omit it; display/sort falls back to entry margin.

botId.description: The first bot of `bots`: the row's bot badge.

bots.description: The bots that hold a part of this position and how much each holds (base units; a running bot's open cycle, its close in flight, or a bot stopped without closing that still holds it); empty for a position nobody's bot holds. The person's part is the size less their sum, never below zero (ruling 397). Absent from a runtime older than 2026-10-09.

name.description: Optional already-held bot name; absent from older runtimes or an unnamed bot. No Bots subscription is needed.

botMismatch.description: The bot's own position differs from the venue's.

openedAt.description: When the position opened, from an opening among the fills the runtime has seen. Absent when it has seen none (a position already open when it first read the account): unknown, never the time of the read. Optional since 2026-10-11; a row of an older runtime always has it.

contributors.description: Origins of open own-trades books, not allocated venue size. Absent means legacy attribution.

forcedClose.description: C66 144: display-only facts from existing admitted liquidation/ADL fills in the preceding 24 hours. No live size, entry, leverage or margin is fabricated. pnl is canonical closed PnL less priced fee; absent for unpriced fee. Partial binding requires positive fill-stream episode evidence; absent/false is unknown or a later episode. Older liquidation records without position metadata yield no fact.
